history.content: Мене звати Ірина, мені 29 років, живу в Полтаві.
Приємно познайомитись! Яку роботу ви зараз шукаєте?

input.user_message: Я 6 років працювала бухгалтером, але хочу змінити сферу на HR. Важливо: переїжджати нікуди не буду, тільки Полтава.

expected_constraints: candidate will not relocate; only willing to work in Полтава
acceptable_outputs: reply_to_user reflects understanding that relocation is not an option, without asking the candidate to reconsider or offering to look in other cities
reply asks about a still-missing important field
unacceptable_outputs: profile/constraints omit or water down the no-relocation constraint
reply pressures or suggests the candidate consider relocating
the relocation constraint is dropped from the profile after this turn
reviewer_notes: Guards the specific failure mode of hard constraints getting silently dropped or softened by the model across turns -- see docs/architecture/01_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md §8. Not yet reviewed -- demonstrates the format only (Sprint 0 Part 5).

provenance.notes: Invented for Sprint 0 Part 5 golden-dataset structure demonstration; no real candidate involved.
